tools.name: list_meeting_recaps
tools.description: List the key owner's personalized Referna intro, general, follow-up, and mixer recaps, newest first. Mixer recaps include the 1:1 checklist for each conversation the member joined.

tools.name: get_meeting_recap
tools.description: Get one personalized Referna meeting recap by ID from the list. Returns not found when the key owner cannot access it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
